title: Physical RAM loader writes invalidate inactive aliased code
commit_subject: feat: invalidate aliased JIT code on physical loader writes

scope.writer: one checked physical RAM byte-range write between native calls

behavior.callback: exact GuestPhysicalRange after successful physical RAM commit
behavior.reconciliation: shared with S4-16b guest MOV writer
behavior.code_page_overlap: read current backing generation and apply invalidation to both alias caches
behavior.other_page_write: preserve code generation and alias cache entries

initial_findings: Strengthened alias re-execution proof with sentinel and retired instruction count
Observed no callback directly on RAM/ROM boundary and ROM failures
Clarified code_invalidated reports applied invalidation, not removal of a resident entry
review.re_review: all findings fixed; no code defects found

limitations: Does not connect every physical RAM writer
No page-table remap or TLB invalidation
No cross-page code, MMIO/DMA, SMP, or active native block mutation
No performance measurement or speed claim
